# braintrust_api_key (Ephemeral Resource)

Generates a Braintrust user API key without storing its data in Terraform plan or state files.

**Ephemeral describes Terraform data, not the remote key lifetime.** The provider does not revoke the key on Close or configuration destruction, and does not automatically rotate it. Callers own secure delivery, store lookup, rotation, expiration, and revocation. The raw `key` is available only at creation.

**Set `nonce = timestamp()` (or `uuid()`) to defer minting until apply.** Terraform opens ephemeral resources during plan when all inputs are known; a literal nonce can mint a key on every plan. Each Open creates a new key. Existing visible same-name keys in the requested organization are rejected, never adopted. When `org_id` is omitted, this safety check conservatively rejects visible same-name keys in any organization.

Creation requires an unrestricted user API key: service tokens, OAuth credentials, and restricted keys cannot mint user keys. The new key belongs to the caller's user. For organization-scoped credentials, `org_id` defaults to and must match the caller's organization. Unscoped user credentials must supply `org_id`, selecting an organization the caller belongs to. A positive `expires_in_seconds` is capped by the caller's remaining lifetime.

An uncertain POST is never retried. Cleanup only revokes a sole newly observed matching key whose ID was returned by this create attempt. Ambiguous candidates require manual inspection and revocation. No recovery ID is retained in state. If downstream delivery fails after a successful Open, inspect and revoke the key before minting a replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires Terraform 1.11.1 or later. Authenticate the Braintrust provider with an
# unrestricted user API key. Service tokens, OAuth credentials, and restricted
# keys cannot create user API keys. The new key belongs to the caller's user.
# Organization-scoped credentials can mint keys only in their own organization.
# Unscoped user credentials must supply org_id for an organization they belong to.
ephemeral "braintrust_api_key" "delivery" {
  # A fresh name avoids adopting or overwriting an existing same-name key.
  name = "terraform-delivery-${uuid()}"

  # Unknown until apply: a literal nonce can mint keys during every plan.
  nonce = timestamp()

  # Defaults to the caller's organization for organization-scoped credentials,
  # and must match that organization if supplied. Required for unscoped user
  # credentials: select an organization the caller belongs to.
  # org_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"

  # Positive lifetime; the API caps it at the caller's remaining lifetime.
  expires_in_seconds = 3600
}

# Deliver ephemeral.braintrust_api_key.delivery.key through an ephemeral-aware
# consumer (for example, a supported write-only secret-store argument). Deliver
# ephemeral.braintrust_api_key.delivery.id with it for later revocation.
# Do not pass the key to ordinary persisted resource arguments or root outputs.
# Terraform does not retain either output in plan/state or revoke the remote key
# when this ephemeral resource closes or the configuration is destroyed.
# Callers own secure delivery, lookup, rotation, expiry, and revocation. If
# delivery fails, inspect/revoke the new key before minting another: the raw key
# cannot be recovered and this resource keeps no recovery ID in state.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key. Use a unique name in the target organization for safe creation and recovery.
- `nonce` (String) Set to timestamp() or uuid() to defer minting until apply. Not sent to the API. A literal value can mint a key during plan.

### Optional

- `expires_in_seconds` (Number) Positive key lifetime in seconds, capped by the caller's remaining lifetime. Omit to use the API's default lifetime.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID. For organization-scoped credentials, defaults to and must match the caller's organization. Required for unscoped user credentials and must select an organization the caller belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String, Sensitive) ID of the created key. Deliver it securely with the key so it can later be revoked.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Raw key, available only at creation. Never stored in Terraform plan or state files; callers must deliver it securely.
